name: Gare Porto 18th Anniversary
description: Celebrate Gare Porto's 18th anniversary with Lady Starlight, Gusta-vo, and Amulador. Expect high-energy electronic music and a vibrant atmosphere.
longDescription:
Gare Porto marks its 18th anniversary with a special nightlife event featuring Lady Starlight, Gusta-vo, and Amulador. Lady Starlight, an American DJ and performance artist, is known for her energetic techno sets and collaborations. Gusta-vo is a Portuguese DJ and producer, a resident at Gare Porto, recognized for his contributions to the local electronic music scene. Amulador, another Portuguese DJ, is also a resident at Gare Porto and a key figure in the club's programming. This event celebrates nearly two decades of Gare Porto as a prominent venue for electronic music in the city.

Attendees can expect an evening of electronic music within the distinctive industrial setting of Gare Porto. The atmosphere will be driven by the performances of the three DJs, catering to an audience familiar with the club's programming and the broader electronic music scene. Gare Porto is known for its underground location, situated beneath the city's main train station, contributing to its unique character as a club space.

Tickets for the Gare Porto 18th Anniversary are available for purchase. Gare Porto is located near Campanhã train station, accessible via metro (Campanhã station, 5-minute walk), bus, or a short taxi ride from central Porto. Information regarding accessibility for individuals with mobility impairments is not specified.
